short_description: Granada HRES high-resolution library, 3000-7000 A only (SVO hres)
description: SVO's Granada HRES library (Martins et al. 2005): high-resolution synthetic spectra covering only about 3000-7000 Angstrom, too little wavelength for broadband photometry on its own.
